description: A shell script for testing the compatibility and proper functioning of Git repositories with different object formats (sha1 and sha256). It sets up multiple repositories, creates various objects (commits, tags, trees, blobs), signs some with GPG, and performs comparison tests to verify object consistency across formats.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive comparison of object properties (size, type, content) between sha1 and sha256 Git repositories for a given object.
